items.text: ETR listed Puka Nacua as GTD/OPTIMISM pregame; Schefter/Rapoport confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders after calf issue.
items.why: Optimism from feeling better Saturday, no setbacks; officially active.
items.implication: Full or near-full WR1 role expected; no major beneficiary shift.

items.text: ETR GTD/PESSIMISM on Breece Hall; confirmed inactive (quad) vs Dolphins, fourth straight miss.
items.why: Limited practice, unlikely per Rapoport; team played safe.
items.implication: Continued absence opens lead back role for handcuff.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY pregame; Schefter/Rapoport confirmed ACTIVE for MNF vs Cowboys.
items.why: Expected then officially up with Dickerson/Stowers.

items.text: Jonah Coleman first game back led Broncos snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%; Dobbins only 21% snaps. LOVE/upgrade; roster in 100% leagues.
items.why: Clear lead shares on return; Harvey fluky TD.
items.implication: Coleman the back to own; Dobbins downgraded.

items.text: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) actually hurt but not certain; watching with Tracy.
items.implication: Potential limited or miss; Tracy also ham.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turn on purposeful slide: almost certainly fine; would be tilting if self-injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Video/analysis; purposeful slide mechanism low force.
items.implication: No expected miss or major role change next week.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT (high ankle sprain, third straight miss).
items.why: Limited practice all week; high-ankle diagnosis explains extended absence.
items.implication: Huntley or backup QB; Flowers/Andrews usage shifts possible.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT; impacts Eagles pass game for MNF.
items.implication: Elevated targets for remaining WRs/TEs; Lemon bet context from Berry.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/activated and expected after absence.
items.why: Activated, listed IN by ETR; Schefter activations.
items.implication: Reclaims lead back role; ROS value discussion.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: worst runner (last in YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) but RB13 PPR via 9 carries inside 5 and league-lead 45 RB targets.
items.implication: Sustainable fantasy RB2 despite poor running; hold/start.

items.text: Tony Pollard exploded Sunday; sell-high opportunity if possible.
items.why: Big game outlier; trade value peak.
items.implication: Capitalize on spike for better asset.

items.text: Texans WR routes (29 Stroud dropbacks): Nico Collins 24 lead; Tank Dell only 6 in return (first since 2024); Noel 15 left early turf toe.
items.why: Clear route hierarchy post-Dell return limited.
items.implication: Nico locked WR1; Dell ramp slow.

items.text: Aaron Jones knee injury not significant; day-to-day.
Xavier Worthy 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd game sans Rice); never topped 83 rec yds in 37 career games.
items.implication: Volume there but historical ceiling limited; monitor efficiency.
